newsitem.title: UK: Fleetwood Mac spin out of UK Formula One TV show.
newsitem.headline: Fleetwood Mac spin out of UK Formula One TV show.

text.p: Britain's Independent Television (ITV), taking over coverage of Formula One Grand Prix motor-racing from the BBC, said on Tuesday it would not be borrowing the BBC's catchy signature tune for its new show.
The fast-twanging guitar solo, lifted from 'The Chain' a song by 1970s rock legend Fleetwood Mac, featured on the BBC's Formula One highlights programme.
Instead ITV has plumped for a specially-commissioned tune penned by relative pop newcomers, Jamiroquai.
ITV, contracted to broadcast Formula One Grand Prix for the next five years, said the new theme combined "drama, excitement and a hint of menace".
Ex-BBC motor racing commentator Murray Walker, known in Britain as the "voice of Formula One", has joined ITV for its coverage of the 1997 season, which starts this weekend in Melbourne.
The BBC covered the motor sport for over two decades before losing the broadcasting rights to ITV.
